# Supported languages

<!-- GENERATED by tool/generate_translations.dart. Do not edit by hand. -->

Country names are bundled for **238 locales**: 202 languages
and 36 regional or script variants, from Unicode CLDR
48.2.0. The selector picks the closest match for the app's locale and falls
back to English.

The last column shows whether the selector's own text ("Select country",
"No country found") is translated for that locale (63 of 238);
otherwise it is shown in English. The search hint always uses Flutter's own
translation.
